## Seoul Korean BBQ Family Dinner Plan for 6

A good fit for **6 people** with **1 vegetarian**, **1 non-spicy diner**, and a **KRW 140,000 cap** is to order a mix of one main meat, one secondary meat, shared vegetables, rice, stew, and a few add-ons that keep everyone covered without over-ordering.

## Recommended Menu and Ordering Strategy

| Item | Approx. Portion | Why it works | Est. Cost |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| Pork belly (samgyeopsal) | 600–700 g total | Crowd-pleaser, mild, easy for the non-spicy diner | KRW 30,000–38,000 |
| Marinated beef or pork (non-spicy style) | 300–400 g total | Adds variety without needing a lot of extra side dishes | KRW 22,000–32,000 |
| Mushroom + onion + zucchini platter | 1 shared platter | Good for the vegetarian and balances the meal | KRW 8,000–15,000 |
| Lettuce, perilla leaves, garlic, sesame oil | 2 shared sets | Lets everyone build wraps and stretch the meat | KRW 6,000–10,000 |
| Steamed egg or tofu side | 1 dish | Mild, filling, and vegetarian-friendly | KRW 6,000–10,000 |
| Doenjang jjigae or soft tofu stew, mild version | 1 pot | Warm shared dish; ask for non-spicy if possible | KRW 7,000–12,000 |
| Rice | 4–6 bowls | Helps satisfy everyone without extra meat | KRW 4,000–8,000 |
| Cold noodles or bibim-naengmyeon, mild if possible | 1 bowl | One shared finishing dish for variety | KRW 8,000–12,000 |

**Estimated total:** **KRW 91,000–127,000**
This leaves room for a drink or one extra side while staying under budget.

## Best Ordering Mix for This Group

- **Meat split:** keep the meat order to **2 proteins total** so the table feels varied but not overloaded.
- **Vegetarian coverage:** make the **mushroom platter, steamed egg or tofu, rice, and stew** the vegetarian base.
- **Non-spicy coverage:** choose **plain grilled pork belly**, **non-spicy marinated meat**, and **mild stew**; ask for **gochujang-based sauces on the side**.
- **Waste control:** start with **one round only**, then add a second small round only if the table finishes the first quickly.

## Efficient Ordering Tips

- Order **all mains at once**: one pork belly set, one smaller marinated meat set, and the vegetable platter.
- Ask for **sauce and seasoning on the side** so the vegetarian and non-spicy diner can stay comfortable.
- Request **extra lettuce/perilla leaves** instead of a third meat item; it makes the meal feel abundant at low cost.
- Keep the stew **mild** and use it as a shared filler dish if the meat portions run small.
- If the restaurant offers **combo sets**, choose a set with **pork + vegetables + stew** only if it stays below the budget; otherwise, à la carte is usually easier to control.
- For 6 people, aim for **about 900–1,100 g total food across meat and hot dishes**, not counting banchan, to avoid leftovers.
